ns2:course.label: Internship in Teaching Comm
ns2:course.description: (SPCOM 204) Supervised experience in assisting in the teaching of an undergraduate course in communication; practice in preparing and presenting brief lectures, conducting activities within class, and assisting students outside of class. Prerequisite: Junior standing, 3.0 grade-point average, 3.5 grade-point average in Speech Communication, recommendation from an instructor, and approval of application.
